A process shaped for residential renovation

Survey, scope, BOQ and phasing are agreed before disruptive work starts.

01

Home survey

Record condition, routines, access and the rooms that must stay usable.

02

Design and 3D approval

Resolve layouts, materials and key views before physical work.

03

Room-by-room BOQ

Price each area and trade so priorities stay visible.

04

Phased renovation

Protect occupied zones and release rooms in an agreed sequence.

05

Final styling and handover

Snag, clean and return the home ready to live in.

items.q: Can we live at home during renovation?
items.a: Often, yes. We plan room-by-room work, dust protection and temporary access around the household routine.

items.a: Yes. These are high-value scopes and can be completed alone or within a whole-home programme.

items.q: Will I see the design before work starts?
items.a: Yes, when design is included. Key rooms and material decisions can be approved through 3D views before execution.

items.a: Yes. We can organise digital approvals, progress updates and documented selections for NRI and overseas clients.
